raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week General Strength Programme for a 42-year-old male with prior L4-L5 disc herniation (no heavy spinal loading or loaded spinal flexion)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build general strength with spinal load precautions"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Full-body foundational strength A":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Squat, barbell (machine-assisted if needed) 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Chest press, machine 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Seated row, cable 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Romanian deadlift (light, maintaining neutral spine) 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Hip bridge with resistance (glute activation) 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Pallof press (cable) 3x12..15 each side rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          single-leg hip flexor stretch 60 seconds each side
          lat stretch 60 seconds each side
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Full-body foundational strength B":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Front squat (or goblet squat) 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Incline press, machine 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Lat pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Dumbbell Romanian deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Glute bridge hold 3x12..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Pallof press with vertical stack 3x12..15 each side rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic mobility sequence 3 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength block 2 A":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Back squat (or leg press if load on spine restricted) 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Barbell bench press (or floor press if needed) 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Barbell row (supported) 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Hip hinge drill (DB Romanian deadlift) 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          walking lunge 3x8..12 each leg rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Farmer's walk 2x30 seconds rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat-cow and thread-the-needle 3 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength block 2 B":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Front squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Overhead press (DB or barbell) 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated cable row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Romanian deadlift with light bar 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Bulgarian split squat (bodyweight or DB) 3x8..10 each leg rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 3x12..15 each side rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip flexor stretch 60 seconds each side
          thoracic rotation 60 seconds each side
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength accumulation A":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Squat 5x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          Bench press 5x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Pull-up or lat pulldown 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Hip hinge variation (DB RDL) 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Step-up with load 3x8..10 each leg rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 3x12..15 each side rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility sequence for hips and thoracic spine 4 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength accumulation B":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Front squat 5x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          Overhead press 5x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Barbell row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Hip thrust 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Bulgarian split squat with DB 3x8..10 each leg rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 3x12..15 each side rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility sequence 4 minutes

SYNTAX RULES:
- Rep ranges use TWO dots, not a dash. Correct: 3x8..12. 
- Sets always come first: 3x10 means 3 sets of 10 reps.
- RPE goes after sets/reps: 3x8..12 rpe 7.
- Rest in seconds: rest 90 seconds
